summary: Baozun Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 2, 2026, attaching a monthly return submitted to the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited regarding movements in authorized and issued share capital for May 2026. The filing reports no changes in share capital during the period, with 470 million A shares and 30 million B shares authorized, and 174,284,503 total issued shares including 13,200,075 treasury shares. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing with no special-situation characteristics.
